description: Waits on the running game. Arm a watch, then send the call that sets a change off. A watch records a change over before your next call. A call sent beside a wait can run during it, noted in ranAlongside. A game held by its debugger answers nothing until it resumes. Operations: frames (needs frames): let frames pass; seconds (needs seconds): let seconds of the game's own time pass, which a headless game's frames are no measure of; signal (needs nodePath and signal, or watch): wait for the signal and answer with what it carried, at once if the watch saw it fire; watch (needs nodePath): record a signal or a property, answering the number signal or recorded takes as watch; recorded (needs watch): what a watch of a property recorded since it was armed; until (needs nodePath, or says): wait for property to read as value, or for the words in says to appear under nodePath.

compare.description: How the property is compared with value. Default ==. Use >= or <= for a counter that steps. For op until.

frames.description: How many to let pass. For op frames.

includeHidden.description: With says: count words on a hidden node or one outside the viewport. Default false. For op until.

nodePath.description: The node, such as "/root/Main/Player" or "%Player". With op until and says, it defaults to /root. For ops signal, watch, until.

pid.description: Which game, when several run from one project: its process id.

projectPath.description: Which game, when several run: its project folder.

property.description: watch: the property to record every frame. until: the property name or a colon path as runtime_inspect reads one. For ops until, watch.

says.description: Wait for these words to appear instead of for a property, matched as runtime_inspect matches says. Not with property. For op until.

seconds.description: The game's own time to let pass, scaled by Engine.time_scale. For op seconds.

signal.description: The signal name. watch takes it or property, not both. For ops signal, watch.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before answering anyway. Default 5000. For ops signal, until.

value.description: The value to wait for, fitted to the property's type and compared at its precision. An enum takes a name or a number, and an object property the text null. For op until.

watch.description: The number an earlier op watch answered, used up by the answer. signal takes it in place of nodePath and signal. For ops signal, recorded.

name: runtime_wait
title: Wait in the running game
